messages:
sara: Heads-up — I consolidated the Orion on‑prem/VPC peering postmortem notes into a short follow-up plan. Root cause looks like a race in our peering reconciliation plus an isolation bug that causes tenant traffic to fall back to the generic routing path. Paste below and proposed owners.
incident-bot: Postmortem doc created: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/orion-2026 — tracker: POST-2245
liam: I can take the peering reconciliation change. Will open a change with infra team and schedule a maintenance window. ETA end-of-week (Fri). CHG-4321.
juan: I'll own the isolation bug (KV cache invalidation that shows up under high‑fanout on-prem setups). Initial triage: reproduce with the onprem test harness, patch will likely need 2–3 days.
elyse: I'll handle customer comms and expectations. Will set an interim mitigation (temporary traffic throttles) and confirm cutover plan with Ops. Ticket: CUST-9912.
sara: Owners summary: peering fix -> @liam (CHG-4321 / INF-9876), isolation bug -> @juan (POST-2245 / PR link when ready), customer comms + mitigation -> @elyse (CUST-9912). Please add exact timelines and blockers by EOD.
liam: Created INF-9876 for the infra playbook update and a config assertion to catch route flaps. I'll attach a runbook snippet.
juan: Quick note — the isolation repro uses the onprem harness with 8k concurrent connections; failing assertion is in kv_cache::apply_update(). I'm starting a debug run now. Will post PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1234 when tests are green.
elyse: Customer update drafted, waiting on liam's maintenance window before sending. Also added this incident to the recurring-incidents board so we can watch trend signals.
sara: Can we get dates: liam EOW, juan + deploy to staging by Tue next week, elyse customer update within 24h after maintenance window? If yes I'll close the immediate follow-ups and spin up a weekly review cadence.
liam: Confirmed EOW for infra change, change scheduled Fri 03:00 UTC, rollback plan included.
juan: Staging deploy by Tue (03/03), assuming no test regressions. If anything blocks I'll flag POST-2245 with severity.
elyse: I'll send the customer note within 24h of the change window and set expectations for a post-change validation call.
sara: Great. Action items appended to POST-2245 and weekly-checkins created (recurrence: weekly, owner: sara). Please add any remaining constraints (onprem firewall windows, cert rotations) to the ticket.
liam: Adding firewall window note — customer's edge team only accepts peering changes Tue/Thu 02:00–06:00 UTC. Marked in INF-9876.
juan: Noting a potential regression vector: model shard alignment during cache rebuilds. I'll add integration tests to avoid silent divergence.
incident-bot: Created follow-ups: INF-9876, POST-2245, CUST-9912, CHG-4321. Links: https://tracker.redwood.com/INF-9876, https://tracker.redwood.com/POST-2245
sara: Thanks all — will run the first weekly review next Wednesday. If anything slips ping me directly. :thumbsup:
liam: :thumbsup:
juan: :thumbsup:
